M1.title: Authenticated tailnet chat stream proof
M1.outcome: From Expo Go on the phone, over the tailnet only, a user can send one prompt to the currently resident Ollama model and watch the reply stream in token by token, protected by a bearer token, with Stop working.

criteria.text: With a model already resident in Ollama, sending a prompt from the Expo Go app over Tailscale Serve renders the reply incrementally, token by token, ending in a terminal complete state.
evidence: e2e-tailnet-proof.sh (live, tailnet URL :8443): 80 content events over ~6.5s ending done status complete — .harness/evidence/M1-T5b-verifier.log
server.test.ts chat streams content then complete — .harness/evidence/M1-T7-verifier.log
On-phone Expo Go rendering: human check, not yet done

criteria.text: A request to any server route without the correct bearer token returns 401; the Mac-side command produces the token, refuses to run if the token file is group- or world-readable, and the app's settings screen accepts a pasted token and uses it on the next request.
evidence: e2e: 7 routes 401 without and with wrong token via tailnet; token command mode 600, refuses 644/640/604 — .harness/evidence/M1-T5b-verifier.log
server.test.ts auth on every route; entry-smoke 7/7 — .harness/evidence/M1-T7-verifier.log
App settings token paste: mobile tests (M1-T6); on-phone paste is a human check, not yet done

criteria.text: Stop cancels generation on the Mac, verified against Ollama, and streaming output halts on the phone.
evidence: e2e: cancel over tailnet -> cancelled terminal event, no bytes after 3s, Ollama log stop: cancel task, runner CPU 2.24s -> 0.00s — .harness/evidence/M1-T5b-verifier.log
Phone output halting: human check, not yet done

criteria.text: The server and the app bundle are reachable from the phone over the tailnet and are not reachable from a device on the LAN or the public internet.

M2.title: Model list, swap-load, and unload with busy confirmation
M2.outcome: The phone shows every installed Ollama model and the true resident state, can load (swap) or unload with a confirmation gate when busy or when another tool owns the resident model, and a loaded model stays resident indefinitely.

criteria.text: The app's model list matches Ollama GET /api/tags by real name and size, with no hardcoded model names.
Loading model A then model B leaves only B resident in GET /api/ps; unloading leaves nothing resident.
A model loaded from the phone remains resident in GET /api/ps after 10 minutes idle and after a chat reply completes.
Swapping or unloading while a reply is in flight, or while the resident model was not loaded by this server, requires explicit confirmation, and cancelling the confirmation leaves state unchanged.
A failed load, such as out of memory, leaves nothing resident and the app shows the failure reason.

M3.title: Persisted multi-turn conversations with model attribution
M3.outcome: The phone keeps a list of conversations, each with full multi-turn history sent on every prompt, each reply labeled with the model that produced it, and conversations survive an app restart.

criteria.text: Conversations can be created, opened and deleted, and are listed newest first.
A follow-up prompt in the same conversation demonstrably uses context from an earlier turn.
Each assistant reply displays the model name that produced it, including after a mid-conversation model switch.
Sending with no model resident is blocked with a prompt to load one.
Force-quitting and reopening Expo Go shows the same conversations and messages as before.

M4.title: Thinking display and dropped-connection resume
M4.outcome: Reasoning output appears collapsed and expandable, separate from the answer, and a transport drop or app backgrounding mid-reply resumes cleanly with no gaps or duplication once the phone reconnects.

criteria.text: For a model that emits reasoning output, the app shows it in a collapsed, expandable section separate from the answer.
Killing the connection mid-reply and reconnecting yields the complete reply with no gaps and no duplicated text.
Backgrounding the app mid-reply and returning to foreground resumes the same reply and receives its terminal state, with only an explicit Stop cancelling generation.

M5.title: Always-on Mac tooling, plain-language errors, and PWA retirement
M5.outcome: The server and app bundle host survive a Mac reboot with no manual step, every failure mode shows a distinct plain-language message, and the old PWA is retired without disturbing the harness's own endpoint.

criteria.text: After a Mac reboot, opening the project in Expo Go on the phone works with no manual step on the Mac.
Killing either the server process or the bundle host process causes it to restart automatically.
The app shows a distinct message for each of: Mac or server unreachable, Ollama down, wrong password, model failed to load, model no longer installed, and reply already in progress.
After retirement, /app no longer resolves, the PWA's LaunchAgent is gone, and the harness's / handler still works.
